tagline: Library for getting structured, validated data out of LLMs.
best_for: Python developers extracting structured data
description:
Instructor is an open-source library that helps you get structured outputs from language models by defining Pydantic models. It handles retries and validation around model calls.

It is used for extraction tasks such as turning text into typed records. Check the official documentation for supported providers and languages.
use_steps: Open the official Instructor site and read what it covers.
Sign up, install or download it, then try a small, low-risk example.
Check the output carefully against what you expected.
Decide whether it fits your workflow before using it on larger or sensitive work.
